About the job

About ConnectPath

 ConnectPath is a Berlin-based B2B introduction partner. We help technology companies enter new markets by connecting them with the right decision-makers through trusted, warm introductions.

For our current project, we are working with a marketing technology company that helps advertisers and agencies recover lost conversion data and measure paid media performance more accurately. We are looking for senior professionals in the performance marketing and paid media space who have trusted relationships with agency leaders and marketing decision-makers.

This is an independent contractor role on a project basis, designed to fit alongside your current professional work.

What success looks like

 You contribute a small number of well-matched introductions that lead to meaningful conversations with paid media and performance marketing leaders. The ConnectPath team handles briefing, scheduling and follow-up, so your time goes into making the right introduction with credibility. Quality matters far more than volume.

Who we want to reach through you

Founders, CEOs and Managing Directors of performance marketing and paid media agencies
Heads of Paid Media, Performance or Media Buying at agencies
CMOs, Heads of Growth and Heads of Digital Marketing at brands with significant paid media budgets

8+ years of experience in performance marketing, paid media, growth marketing, ad tech or digital agency environments

Strong profiles include current or former agency founders and partners, senior performance marketing consultants, ad platform partner managers, and marketing technology sales or partnership leaders
Familiarity with tracking, attribution and conversion measurement challenges is a strong plus

Independent contractor engagement, fully remote, with flexible hours
Project-based fee: a fixed fee is agreed upfront for each project and paid for each completed introduction meeting
You keep 100% of your agreed fee
You choose which projects to take on, with no minimum commitment

How it works

A short intro call to learn about your background and market relationships
Onboarding and contractor agreement

 Applicant information is used only to evaluate fit for the Connector program and is never shared with clients without your consent.

description:
About the job

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Our Marketing Growth team runs the consumer programs that reach millions of shoppers — subscriptions, giveaways, surveys, and lifecycle campaigns across email, push, in-app, and landing pages. This role sits where marketing meets data, engineering and product. You'll write the queries that tell us whether a program actually worked, design the tests that answer questions we'd otherwise be guessing at, and translate between the marketing team and the engineers who build the surfaces we run on.

As a Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern, you will play a critical role in measuring and improving the programs that drive our consumer business. A core focus will be writing the queries and building the reporting that tell us whether a program worked, and designing the tests that answer the questions we would otherwise be guessing at. In addition to analysis, you will work closely with Product and Engineering to translate marketing needs into clear requirements and to identify what we would need built to make new programs possible. This role is well suited to someone with a technical background who is drawn to the business and product side of the work, and who wants exposure to how marketing decisions actually get made.

What You'll Do:

Answer questions with data


Write your own SQL to pull campaign, cohort, and subscription performance.
Track the metrics that drive the business: DAU, NTM, LTV, CAC
Compare performance across time periods and segments, and flag the shifts that matter before anyone asks.
Take ownership of the dashboards behind our decisions, and use AI to find the answers hiding in them


Design and measure experiments


Help design A/B tests across channels — audience splits, variants, and success metrics defined before anything launches
Write the post-test analysis: what worked, what didn't, what we do differently next time
Own consumer surveys from request to results: define and query the audience, launch, monitor completion, report back what we learned, and optimize the process


Bridge marketing and engineering


Turn marketing needs into specs and tickets an engineer can act on 
Investigate when something breaks — trace an issue through dashboards and logs back to its source
QA new product features and surfaces, and help decide how marketing should be using them
Spot underused channels and product surfaces, and propose how marketing could leverage them


Automate And Improve How We Work


Use AI tools (Claude and similar) to build leverage into your own work — recurring reports, first-pass analyses, triage. If a task comes back every week, we'd rather you automate it
Build automations and templates the rest of the team can use
Own recurring operational queues and look for the pattern behind repeat problems instead of just clearing them


What We Look For:

Skills & Competencies


Basic working knowledge of SQL.
Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, or HTML/CSS, and enough comfort reading code. 
More interested in the business and product side than in engineering for its own sake. You want to know why the number moved, not only how the system works
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
You get the most out of AI. Claude, ChatGPT, or similar are already part of how you work — research, summaries, first-pass analyses — and you're constantly exploring what else they can handle
Comfort working in agile, matrixed teams with multiple inputs and quick turnarounds
A strong bias for action


Educational & Professional Experience


Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in engineering, computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, or a related technical field
Exposure to BI tools (Redash/SIA, Looker, Tableau, or similar) is a plus
Prior experience with a CRM platform like Braze is a plus
Any experience with product management, experiment design, or A/B testing is a plus
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern is $800 USD monthly gross.

About the job

At the heart of some of Seco's most important global marketing initiatives, you lead campaigns that create business impact across markets and regions. Combining strategic direction with hands-on leadership, you bring people together, drive momentum, and ensure successful delivery in a complex global environment.

About The Job

In this position, you lead the activation and delivery of large-scale global marketing campaigns that support business objectives and strengthen market impact. Working across functions, regions, and external partners, you bring people together around a shared vision and ensure campaigns are executed successfully from concept through delivery. As a senior member of the Marketing Activation team, you also contribute to strengthening campaign excellence across the function through guidance and support to colleagues.

Job Responsibilities


Lead the activation and execution of global marketing campaigns.
Build and coordinate cross-functional project teams, including external partners and agencies.
Develop campaign activation plans, content strategies, budgets, and timelines.
Shape campaign messaging and value propositions that resonate with target audiences.
Review and approve creative concepts, designs, content, and campaign assets across multiple channels.
Monitor campaign performance, manage risks, and present recommendations and results to senior stakeholders.


Location and flexibility

This position is based in the Americas. Preferred locations are Mexico or Brazil, although candidates located in the United States or Canada are also considered.

Your profile

You’re an experienced marketing professional with a strong track record of leading complex, integrated campaigns in an international environment. Success in this position comes from your ability to align stakeholders, drive momentum, and translate business objectives into compelling marketing initiatives.

Your background includes


Proven experience leading integrated marketing campaigns from strategy through execution.
A strong background in marketing, brand building, communications, campaign management, or a related discipline.
Experience leading cross-functional project teams across multiple stakeholders and regions.
Strong storytelling, messaging, and campaign development capabilities.
Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and presentation skills, including engagement with senior leaders.


You bring a collaborative leadership style and enjoy supporting colleagues while creating structure in complex environments. With a strong commercial mindset and data-informed approach, you balance creativity with execution and continuously look for ways to strengthen campaign performance and business impact.

What We Offer

For U.S.-based employees, we offer a competitive salary, performance-based incentives, and the following benefits:


401(k) with up to 8% company match
Generous PTO and 11 paid holidays
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
Company laptop, phone, and tools to succeed
Tuition reimbursement and paid volunteer time
Wellness programs and employee referral bonus


Competitive salaries and standard benefit packages apply in Brazil, Canada, and Mexico.

About the job

MYSTRA — Looking for a Co-Founder / Business Partner

mymystra.com 

https://www.instagram.com/mymystra




I’m looking for someone to build Mystra with me.

Mystra started as a passion project and has grown into a Mexico City–based luxury fragrance and sensual wellness brand. We recently launched our signature fragrance, and I’m now at the point where I don’t want to build the next stage of the company alone.




I’m looking for a commercially minded, entrepreneurial partner who can complement my strengths and share the responsibility of turning Mystra into a bigger, global brand.

This is not a traditional job. And I’m not necessarily looking for someone who is ready to quit their current position tomorrow.




I’m open to different ways of building this together. It could start alongside your current role, as a serious side venture, or evolve into a full-time commitment as we grow and raise capital together.

Someone who enjoys building — not just advising.




You might have a background in:




• Sales & business development

• Marketing & brand growth

• Retail & distribution

• E-commerce

• Partnerships

• Fundraising / investor relations

→ Revenue and growth strategy

→ Sales and distribution

→ Retail and strategic partnerships

→ New market expansion

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. If you’re analytical, detail-oriented, and organized, but also excited to roll up your sleeves and get your hands dirty, you’d fit right in. About the job

Growth & Operations Lead — Cuentista (un venture de Igeneris)




Acerca de nosotros

En Igeneris nos dedicamos a transformar empresas. Diseñamos, construimos y escalamos negocios que revolucionan industrias, generando cientos de millones de euros en ingresos. Con el mejor talento y metodologías probadas, ayudamos a las empresas a crecer, diferenciarse y evolucionar de manera responsable. En Igeneris damos vida a las ideas.




El venture: Cuentista

Esta vacante es para uno de nuestros ventures en México. Cuentista es una startup mexicana que crea cuentos infantiles 100% personalizados con IA, donde el hijo o hija del cliente es el protagonista real de la historia: su nombre, su físico, su familia, su casa… y el reto que está viviendo en ese momento.

No vendemos libros bonitos. Vendemos una herramienta para que mamás y papás acompañen los retos de verdad: la llegada de un hermanito, el primer día de escuela, una mudanza, una conversación difícil, aprender a nombrar lo que siente. Cuando el niño se ve a sí mismo en la historia, interioriza el mensaje y lo pone en práctica. Esa es la magia, y los números lo confirman.

Cuentista ya está en el mercado, vendiendo y creciendo mes a mes. Entras a un negocio real, no a un piloto.




El reto

Hoy Cuentista funciona. El producto convierte, el cliente lo ama y la operación saca los pedidos. El siguiente capítulo es otro: pasar de una operación artesanal que funciona a una máquina que escala.

Buscamos a la persona que tome ese reto de punta a punta. No es un puesto de "ejecutar un plan que ya existe". Es un puesto para construir el plan, automatizarlo y después liderarlo.

Si te emociona la idea de que en 12 meses puedas señalar un canal de venta, un proceso automatizado y un equipo que no existían antes de que tú llegaras, sigue leyendo.




Qué vas a hacer

1. Ser el dueño de la operación de Cuentista

Que cada cuento salga a tiempo, con la calidad que prometimos y con el cliente contento. Desde que entra el pedido hasta que la familia abre el paquete. Vas a conocer el negocio desde adentro antes de reinventarlo.

2. Liderar la automatización de los procesos

Hoy muchos pasos son manuales: revisión del cuento, cambios del cliente, seguimiento por WhatsApp. Tu misión es convertir eso en un sistema: menos toques humanos, más volumen, mismo nivel de calidad. Vas a trabajar de la mano del equipo de producto y tendrás toda la libertad para usar herramientas de IA y no-code.

3. Expandir nuestro GTM y hacer crecer el B2C

Más allá de la pauta en Meta: alianzas con creadores, referidos, CRM y recompra sobre nuestra base de clientes, nuevos formatos, fechas clave (Día del Niño, Día del Padre, Navidad). Aquí experimentas, mides, matas lo que no funciona y escalas lo que sí.

4. Construir el canal B2B desde cero

Museos, escuelas, fundaciones, hospitales, marcas que quieren regalar algo que sí se recuerda. Tenemos conversaciones abiertas y cero estructura. Es la apuesta con mayor potencial del negocio y va a ser tuya.

5. Liderar al equipo de operación

Empiezas liderando un equipo pequeño que crecerá conforme escalemos. Formar, organizar, priorizar y sacar lo mejor de ellos es parte del trabajo.




A quién buscamos

Pedimos hambre, criterio y capacidad de resolver. Esta posición impactará el futuro de la empresa.

Indispensable:

~2-4 años de experiencia en startups, growth, marketing digital, consultoría, operaciones o e-commerce (o un proyecto propio que hayas sacado adelante)
Perfil generalista y resolutivo: igual te metes a arreglar un pedido atorado que a armar una propuesta comercial

AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables

2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado

About the job

We’re hiring: Client Experience Specialist




We’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping people, solving problems, and having conversations with customers.




At Memory Ventures, this role is about more than just answering emails or closing tickets. We want someone who can listen to a customer, understand what they actually need, figure out the best solution, and make sure they leave the conversation feeling taken care of.




You’ll also have opportunities to recommend products and services when they make sense for the customer. We’re not looking for someone who pushes a sale just to hit a number. We’re looking for someone who knows how to recognize a need and have a natural sales conversation around it.




What you’ll be doing:

Providing customer support through email, chat, and phone
Helping customers troubleshoot issues and finding solutions
Understanding customer needs and recommending the right products or services
Following up and taking ownership of customer issues through resolution
Keeping customer interactions and notes organized in our CRM/helpdesk system
Working with other teams when additional support is needed
Working toward customer satisfaction and sales goals
Looking for ways to improve the customer experience along the way




What we’re looking for:

1–2 years of customer service experience
At least 1 year of sales experience, preferably in retail, upselling, inbound sales, or a call center
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Someone who can stay calm and solution-focused when things get difficult
Good judgment and the ability to figure out the right approach for different situations
Comfortable switching between customer service and sales conversations
Organized and able to manage multiple priorities
Comfortable working with KPIs and sales goals
Someone who takes initiative and can work independently
Experience with a CRM, helpdesk, ticketing system, or similar platform




The kind of person who will do well on our team:

You care about how people are treated.




You don't need to have every answer right away, but you know how to find one.




You take ownership instead of passing problems along.




You’re comfortable receiving feedback, learning as you go, and adjusting when something can be done better.




And you’re someone who can work independently while still being a good teammate.




A few details:

Schedule: 9:00 AM–5:30 PM EST

Salary: $1,000/month

Work setup: Remote




You’ll need a reliable internet connection and a dependable work-from-home setup, including a backup plan for unexpected internet or power issues.




If this sounds like the kind of role and team you’d enjoy being part of, we’d love to hear from you.

Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Product Owner, you will set priorities for the squad and groom the Product Backlog to ensure the most valuable and time-critical items are at the top. You will interact with the Iteration Manager/Scrum Master, Development Team, and Client to understand the product and translate it into priorities for the squad.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include


 Prioritize Product Backlog: Place the most valuable and time-critical items at the top of the backlog to ensure the squad is working on the most important tasks.
 Collaborate with Stakeholders: Interact with the Iteration Manager/Scrum Master, Development Team, and Client to understand their needs and expectations.
 Translate Client Needs: Understand the product and client requirements and translate them into priorities for the squad to ensure effective solution delivery.
 Manage Product Backlog: Continuously groom the Product Backlog to ensure it is up-to-date and reflects the changing needs of the client and stakeholders.
 Communicate Priorities: Clearly communicate priorities to the squad and stakeholders to ensure everyone is aligned and working towards the same goals.


Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

The Agile Technical Product Owner (Advisor) is accountable for maximizing business value and technical health across one or more technology products within an Agile Release Train (ART). Serving as the internal voice of the customer, this role bridges business strategy and agile delivery by translating enterprise and portfolio objectives into prioritized features and stories. The Advisor partners closely with business stakeholders, Product Managers, architects, and engineering teams to ensure secure, compliant, and sustainable delivery of high quality outcomes aligned to the enterprise roadmap.

This role requires strong technical acumen, agile delivery expertise, and the ability to operate effectively across complex, cross functional, and enterprise scale environments while providing guidance and thought leadership on complex initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership & Value Delivery


 Own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for assigned technical products or Agile Release Train scope
 Define, prioritize, and manage features and stories to ensure delivery of the highest business value
 Translate strategic objectives and business needs into well defined features, user stories, and acceptance criteria
 Ensure iterative delivery of value through Minimum Viable Products, epics, features and planned increments (stories)


Agile Planning & Execution


 Own and maintain healthy feature and story backlogs, ensuring Definition of Ready and Definition of Done are met
 Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, PI planning, reviews, and retrospectives
 Partner with Delivery Managers and agile teams to ensure work is planned, executed, and completed on schedule
 Identify, manage, and escalate risks and cross team dependencies as needed
 Leverage agile tools (e.g., Jira) and metrics to manage flow, throughput, and backlog health


Stakeholder & Cross Functional Collaboration


 Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and delivery teams
 Communicate product direction, trade offs, progress, and risks clearly and effectively
 Maintain awareness of portfolio level initiatives to proactively manage alignment and dependencies
 Provide advisory guidance and recommendations to leadership on complex or high impact initiatives


Technical & Product Health Ownership


 Partner with engineering and architecture to incorporate technical improvements, platform needs, and architectural guidance into the backlog
 Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, compliance, and technology standards
 Monitor product health indicators such as KPIs, defects, and compliance metrics to support long term sustainability


Required Qualifications


 Bachelor’s degree in a technical or related field (or equivalent experience)
Experience: 7–9 Years
 3–5 years of experience working in Agile / Scrum or SAFe delivery environments
 Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, APIs, data platforms, or enterprise systems
 Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into business friendly language
 Strong knowledge of JIRA
 Strong prioritization, analytical, and decision making skills


Preferred Technical And Professional Experience


 Experience as a Technical Product Owner, Product Owner, or similar role in a large enterprise
 Experience supporting Agile Release Trains and managing cross team dependencies
 Familiarity with regulated domains, data & analytics platforms, or healthcare technology
 Comfort using agile and product health metrics to guide prioritization and delivery decisions


Success Characteristics


 Demonstrates strong ownership and accountability for outcomes
 Balances business value, technical feasibility, and risk effectively
 Recognized as a trusted advisor and collaborator across business and technology
 Comfortable operating in ambiguity while driving clarity, structure, and alignment

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Consumer Trading is a full-stack team behind the Consumer experience in Kraken mobile and web applications. Our flagship product allows our clients to instantly buy, sell, convert any combination of stocks, cryptocurrencies and cash. You’ll be a critical member of the Engage group, responsible for building long-term product value and loyalty across our Kraken products—on both mobile and web.

The opportunity


Define the product strategy and roadmap for engagement and loyalty across Kraken and Pro, aligning it with our growth goals and business unit objectives.
Own key product metrics such retention rate, session frequency, and LTV.
Drive product development across the full lifecycle—from discovery and validation to launch and iteration—with a focus on utility, repeat usage, and behavioral reinforcement
Develop and implement growth loops and in-product mechanics that encourage usage frequency and depth, including gamification, rewards, social features, and habit-forming design
Collaborate with Engineering, Design, and Analytics to run A/B and multivariate tests at scale, leveraging results to make fast, data-informed decisions
Partner with Marketing and Lifecycle teams to build targeted engagement campaigns and personalized messaging strategies (e.g., push, in-app, email) based on behavioral insights
Design and refine client segmentation frameworks to personalize the experience and optimize journeys
Collaborate closely with Business Leads for Consumer and Pro segments to align product goals with user personas, market demands, and business objectives


What You Bring


5+ years of product management experience, with 2+ years focused on engagement, retention, or lifecycle growth (preferably in crypto or fintech)
Strong analytical skills with a proven ability to use data to drive decision-making
Experience in growth product management with a solid understanding of experimentation, funnel optimization, and behavioral psychology
A track record of launching successful engagement features such as notifications systems, loyalty/rewards programs, or community-driven features
Experience working with both mobile and web apps, and comfort navigating technical conversations with engineers
Deep empathy for users combined with a strong business sense
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; you can influence at multiple levels of the organization
Experience working with both mobile and web apps, and comfort navigating technical conversations with engineers
Enthusiasm for Bitcoin and the cryptocurrency ecosystem, with a deep belief in our mission


Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. About the job

Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Product Owner, you will set priorities for the squad and groom the Product Backlog to ensure the most valuable and time-critical items are at the top. You will interact with the Iteration Manager/Scrum Master, Development Team, and Client to understand the product and translate it into priorities for the squad.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include


 Prioritize Product Backlog: Place the most valuable and time-critical items at the top of the backlog to ensure the squad is working on the most important tasks.
 Collaborate with Stakeholders: Interact with the Iteration Manager/Scrum Master, Development Team, and Client to understand their needs and expectations.
 Translate Client Needs: Understand the product and client requirements and translate them into priorities for the squad to ensure effective solution delivery.
 Manage Product Backlog: Continuously groom the Product Backlog to ensure it is up-to-date and reflects the changing needs of the client and stakeholders.
 Communicate Priorities: Clearly communicate priorities to the squad and stakeholders to ensure everyone is aligned and working towards the same goals.


Preferred Education

Bachelor's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

The Agile Technical Product Owner (Advisor) is accountable for maximizing business value and technical health across one or more technology products within an Agile Release Train (ART). Serving as the internal voice of the customer, this role bridges business strategy and agile delivery by translating enterprise and portfolio objectives into prioritized features and stories. The Advisor partners closely with business stakeholders, Product Managers, architects, and engineering teams to ensure secure, compliant, and sustainable delivery of high quality outcomes aligned to the enterprise roadmap.

This role requires strong technical acumen, agile delivery expertise, and the ability to operate effectively across complex, cross functional, and enterprise scale environments while providing guidance and thought leadership on complex initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership & Value Delivery


 Own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for assigned technical products or Agile Release Train scope
 Define, prioritize, and manage features and stories to ensure delivery of the highest business value
 Translate strategic objectives and business needs into well defined features, user stories, and acceptance criteria
 Ensure iterative delivery of value through Minimum Viable Products, epics, features and planned increments (stories)


Agile Planning & Execution


 Own and maintain healthy feature and story backlogs, ensuring Definition of Ready and Definition of Done are met
 Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, PI planning, reviews, and retrospectives
 Partner with Delivery Managers and agile teams to ensure work is planned, executed, and completed on schedule
 Identify, manage, and escalate risks and cross team dependencies as needed
 Leverage agile tools (e.g., Jira) and metrics to manage flow, throughput, and backlog health


Stakeholder & Cross Functional Collaboration


 Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and delivery teams
 Communicate product direction, trade offs, progress, and risks clearly and effectively
 Maintain awareness of portfolio level initiatives to proactively manage alignment and dependencies
 Provide advisory guidance and recommendations to leadership on complex or high impact initiatives


Technical & Product Health Ownership


 Partner with engineering and architecture to incorporate technical improvements, platform needs, and architectural guidance into the backlog
 Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, compliance, and technology standards
 Monitor product health indicators such as KPIs, defects, and compliance metrics to support long term sustainability


Required Qualifications


 Bachelor’s degree in a technical or related field (or equivalent experience)
Experience: 7–9 Years
 3–5 years of experience working in Agile / Scrum or SAFe delivery environments
 Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, APIs, data platforms, or enterprise systems
 Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into business friendly language
 Strong knowledge of JIRA
 Strong prioritization, analytical, and decision making skills


Preferred Technical And Professional Experience


 Experience as a Technical Product Owner, Product Owner, or similar role in a large enterprise
 Experience supporting Agile Release Trains and managing cross team dependencies
 Familiarity with regulated domains, data & analytics platforms, or healthcare technology
 Comfort using agile and product health metrics to guide prioritization and delivery decisions


Success Characteristics

 Recognized as a trusted advisor and collaborator across business and technology

About the job

FICO (NYSE: FICO) is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

The Opportunity 

This hybrid executive role calls for a unique leader who is fifty percent market-facing revenue accelerator and fifty percent internal engineering builder. You will serve as the company's elite technical authority in front of Fortune 500 customers, co-selling and architecting high-value AI solutions alongside the sales team to drive new ARR, while simultaneously leading, scaling, and operationalizing our internal engineering organization to deliver the platform capabilities required to support those enterprise wins. The mission: to aggressively drive enterprise market expansion and ARR growth by serving as the executive technical closer for strategic deals, while scaling a world-class AI engineering organization capable of shipping production-grade, secure software.

What You'll Contribute


Partner directly with Sales Leadership to act as the primary executive technical resource, compressing enterprise sales cycles for FICO’s largest strategic customers. 
Co-create, whiteboard, and formalize production-grade AI architectures for complex, multi-cloud enterprise deployments that satisfy client CIOs, CISOs, and Chief Data Officers.

Recruit, mentor, and retain top-tier talent across full-stack, AI infrastructure, and MLOps disciplines, growing the organization to meet enterprise demands without diluting culture. 
Implement rigorous agile processes and software delivery metrics to ensure enterprise features, compliance updates, and AI models are continuously tested, validated, and shipped on schedule. 
Oversee the core codebase, cloud infrastructure topologies, and GPU/compute budgets to maintain high gross margin efficiency while supporting heavy client workloads. 



What We're Seeking


Exceptional executive presence and commercial acumen, with the ability to command a boardroom, confidently whiteboard deep technical concepts to non-technical C-suite buyers, and handle intense commercial and technical objections. 
Mastery of deal strategy and scoping, translating ambiguous customer business problems into concrete, well-scoped proofs of concept that clearly demonstrate ROI and tie directly back to core platform capabilities. 
Expertise in LLM orchestration and frameworks, including LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and custom multi-agent execution workflows. 
Deep understanding of vector databases and enterprise RAG, including Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone, or pgvector, to build advanced, secure retrieval-augmented generation architectures. 
Experience with model lifecycle and MLOps tools, including Weights & Biases, MLflow, Kubeflow, Triton Inference Server, and Hugging Face ecosystems. 
Architecture experience with data pipelines and data gravity, including Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Spark, and high-throughput enterprise data pipelines. 
Authoritative knowledge of deploying AI within highly regulated frameworks, including SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, GDPR, FedRAMP, and the EU AI Act.

Experience with cloud topologies, including AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) in hybrid-cloud settings.

An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. Buscamos unAnalista en Tiempo Real (RTA) quien será responsable de garantizar la continuidad y eficiencia operativa mediante el monitoreo en tiempo real de indicadores clave, la gestión y seguimiento de incidencias técnicas en aplicativos internos y la coordinación estratégica entre distintas áreas para asegurar el cumplimiento de objetivos operativos y comerciales.

Este rol actúa como punto central de visibilidad operativa, anticipando desviaciones, identificando riesgos en la operación y coordinando acciones inmediatas que permitan mantener la estabilidad del negocio y la experiencia del cliente.

La posición representa una excelente oportunidad para perfiles analíticos interesados en desarrollar experiencia en operaciones, análisis de datos y toma de decisiones en tiempo real dentro de un entorno dinámico y de alto crecimiento.

Monitoreo operativo en tiempo real

About the Role

As a Customer Operations Coordinator, you’ll support the day-to-day operations of a New York-based business, making sure sales orders, pricing, costs, and customer information are processed accurately and efficiently. You’ll start with a strong focus on back-end operational work, then take on more direct customer communication as you learn the business and demonstrate proficiency.

This is a role for someone who thinks rather than simply processes. When a number, price, margin, or order does not make sense, you’ll be expected to investigate it, double-check the information, and confidently raise questions before moving forward.

Maintain a high level of accuracy while efficiently handling significant volumes of order and operational data.
Support customer inquiries professionally through email as your knowledge of the business grows.

Previous customer service, customer-facing, or operational support experience.

description:
About the job

Position Summary

The Wholesale Trade Marketing Manager will be responsible for developing and executing the Trade Marketing strategy for the Wholesale channel in Mexico, with a strong focus on accelerating sell-out, strengthening brand visibility, improving in-store execution, and driving commercial performance across key wholesale partners.

This role will work closely with Sales, Brand Marketing, Supply Chain, Product and Finance to translate brand and commercial priorities into impactful initiatives at the point of sale and across partners' digital platforms.

The ideal candidate combines a strong commercial mindset, strategic thinking and hands-on execution, with deep knowledge of the Mexican wholesale and indirect retail landscape.




Key Responsibilities

Wholesale Trade Marketing Strategy: Develop and execute the annual Trade Marketing plan for the Wholesale channel, defining priorities, commercial moments, product launches, activations and investment strategies aligned with business objectives.
Sell-Out Acceleration: Design and implement programs to accelerate sell-out across wholesale partners, identifying key commercial opportunities, seasonal moments and promotional initiatives to drive product rotation and revenue.
In-Store Activations & Brand Visibility: Develop and execute high-impact point-of-sale initiatives, including POP materials, displays, visual merchandising solutions, product launches and consumer experiences that strengthen brand presence.
Wholesale Partner Development: Build strong relationships with key wholesale partners, understanding their commercial dynamics and identifying opportunities to increase brand visibility, distribution and sell-through.
Digital & E-Wholesale Execution: Develop digital Trade Marketing initiatives with key partners to increase traffic, conversion and brand visibility across their e-commerce platforms and digital channels.
Sales Force Training: Create and implement product training programs, sales clinics and tools for wholesale partners' sales teams to strengthen product knowledge, storytelling and conversion at the point of sale.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Key Account Managers, Brand Marketing, Product, Supply Chain and Finance to ensure successful product launches, inventory availability and execution of commercial initiatives.
Budget & Investment Management: Manage the Wholesale Trade Marketing budget and co-investment programs, ensuring effective allocation of resources and maximizing return on investment.
Performance & KPI Management: Track and analyze key indicators including sell-in, sell-out, product rotation, campaign performance, inventory and ROI to identify opportunities and optimize future initiatives.
Market & Competitive Intelligence: Monitor competitors, market trends, consumer behavior and execution at point of sale to identify opportunities and provide actionable recommendations to the business.




Candidate Profile

5+ years of experience in Trade Marketing, Wholesale Marketing, Commercial Marketing or related roles, ideally within fashion, sports, lifestyle, footwear, apparel or consumer goods.
Strong experience managing Wholesale, indirect channels, distributors and/or traditional wholesalers in Mexico.
Proven experience developing and executing sell-out strategies, point-of-sale activations and commercial campaigns.
Strong understanding of pricing, margins, promotional mechanics, commercial investments and budget management.
Strong negotiation and relationship-management skills, with the ability to partner effectively with commercial teams and external wholesale accounts.
Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional projects involving Sales, Marketing, Product, Supply Chain and Finance.
Analytical and commercially driven mindset, with the ability to translate data into actionable business opportunities.
Strong project-management and execution skills, with the ability to manage multiple partners, campaigns and priorities simultaneously.
High availability to visit wholesale partners and points of sale throughout Mexico, ensuring strong execution in the field.
Advanced English preferred.




What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means delivering stronger sell-out, greater brand visibility, better execution at point of sale and stronger partnerships with Wholesale accounts, while ensuring Trade Marketing investments directly support the company's commercial growth.




This is a full-time, on-site position, based at our Santa Fe office in Mexico City, Monday through Friday.

You have 10+ years of experience in growth, product, or marketing design, with a strong portfolio of shipped, top-of-funnel work that drove measurable business impact (lead generation, conversion lift, acquisition). Your portfolio shows both craft and outcomes.

You drive growth through experimentation. You've designed and run A/B and multivariate tests, built and scaled experimentation programs, and moved quickly from hypothesis to live experiment without dropping your quality bar.

You understand SEO and conversion rate optimization deeply, and you design with them in mind. You know how information architecture, landing page structure, page speed, and content strategy affect discoverability and conversion. You also stay ahead of how AI is transforming organic search and discovery, evolving site architecture and content strategy to remain optimized for SEO and localized (GEO) behaviors.

You think in systems and you strengthen the ones that already exist. You've designed for CMS-driven platforms and modular frameworks, and you've built and contributed to reusable components inside a shared design systems so the whole team ships faster and more consistently.

You're deep in Figma: auto-layout, AI prototyping, and a track record of contributing to design systems there rather than working around them. You hold a high bar for usability, accessibility and brand integrity, and you treat brand and conversion as the same goal.

Own conversion rate optimization from a design perspective: form hypotheses, design experiments, and iterate based on test results, funnel data, and growth metrics (MQLs, CAC, LTV).
Refine site-wide information architecture to improve discoverability, navigation, and conversion efficiency, and evolve our content strategy for SEO and AI-driven search (GEO).
Design high-performing lead-capture experiences — forms, gated content, and CRM-integrated workflows — and partner with marketing and revenue ops to improve lead qualification and handoff.

Extend the systems we already have (the web design system, the email design system, brand guidelines) so they serve growth and experimentation needs. You decide whether the pattern earns a place in the system and build the component in Figma.

Partner closely with Growth Marketing, Brand, Web/Engineering, and Data to translate behavioral and search insights into scalable, on-brand, accessible experiences. You'll be active in what Brand Studio ships: critique, design review, and the systems.
Bring a high creative bar to performance-driven work, balancing brand integrity with funnel optimization.

Set the standard for growth design practice across Brand Studio — mentoring designers and fostering craft, experimentation, and AI fluency.

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. Our code of conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here.

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. Company Overview

The company is a commercial finance intermediary specializing in SBA-guaranteed financing. They source, structure, and place 7(a) and 504 transactions with a network of national and regional SBA lenders — with particular depth in business acquisition financing, including partial buyouts, change-of-ownership transactions, and search-fund and independent-sponsor deals.

They are not a lender. They are the party that gets a deal properly structured, matched to the right lender's credit box, and driven to a funded close. Their value is judgment and lender relationships, not volume for its own sake.

Role Overview

They are adding a Business Development Officer to originate SBA loan opportunities on a commission-only basis. This is a producer role for someone who already has a referral network and knows how to work it — not a role where we hand you a lead list and a script.

You will own your pipeline end to end: sourcing clients and selling a $2,500 - $3,000 buy side consulting agreement, sourcing referral relationships, qualifying opportunities against real lender appetite, and shepherding files from initial conversation to funding. title: Client Advisor, Monterrey
description:
About the job

Job Description



This iconic Australian brand has stayed true to its original vision: sophisticated femininity, a passion for detail and a love of colour and print. Sisters Nicky and Simone ZIMMERMANN founded their namesake brand in Sydney in 1991.

Early in its evolution, ZIMMERMANN took the bold step of fusing fashion with swimwear and presented it to the world. It immediately found its following with the fashion elite, creating a new point of reference in flattering, feminine and stylish swimwear. While the swimsuit thrust ZIMMERMANN on to the international stage, it has been its optimistic, feminine and consistently desirable collections across its ready-to-wear and resort that have propelled it to greater global appeal.



Job Requirements



· Capability and drive to reach KPIs and Sales Targets

· Demonstrates professionalism, optimism and team orientated approach

· Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills

· Previous sales experience in luxury designer fashion

· A passionate brand ambassador who embodies the Zimmermann values

· Ability to cultivate Zimmermann’s brand loyalty though positive client interactions

· Detailed orientated

· Excellent organisational skills and problem-solving ability

· A passion for exceeding customer expectations

· Ability to build ongoing rapport with clientele

· Ability to work independently and as part of a team



Job Responsibilities



· Achieving sales targets and store KPI’s whilst upholding Zimmermann’s brand standards including store and visual presentation, stock and inventory

· To ensure that an exemplary standard of client service is provided to Zimmermann’s clientele in line with the brand’s global vision

· Acquire and grow the Zimmermann client database through engaging and maintaining professional client relationships

· Ensure that a consistently high standard of visual presentation is achieved and reflective of the brand directives

· Have a thorough understanding of company policy and procedure relating to store operations, stock and loss prevention

· Engaging in team training and development initiatives including product and brand knowledge, sustainability, diversity and Work Health Safety



Job Benefits



· Bespoke career development plans and access to strong mentors and industry leaders

· Opportunity to grow within an Australian luxury fashion brand with opportunities to work globally

· Competitive package, seasonal uniforming and team member discount

· Be part of a responsible fashion house with a focus in leading in sustainability

In addition to monthly pay ($16,000 - $20,000 MXN), Client Advisors are also eligible for commission on all sales.




Salary



20000 - 20000 MXN (monthly)

description:
About the job

Who We Are

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About The Role

Motive is seeking a driven Account Executive to help build and expand our sales organization in our newest regional market — México. As one of the founding members of this team, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating growth, building customer relationships from the ground up, and shaping how Motive delivers value in the region.

You will leverage Motive’s strong product positioning and proven global success to identify new opportunities, close business, and bring measurable impact to our customers’ operations. This is an ideal role for a high-performing Sales Development Representative (SDR) or Business Development Representative (BDR) who has mastered the art of prospecting and is ready to take the next step into a full-cycle closing role. We are looking for individuals who thrive in fast-moving environments, love building markets, and want to grow within a world-class organization.

This is a hybrid position based in México City, with occasional travel required for client meetings.

What You’ll Do


Own the full sales cycle – from prospecting and pipeline generation to closing and onboarding new customers. 
Develop new business by building strong relationships with key prospects and stakeholders. 
Consistently exceed sales targets, driving growth across Small & Medium Business accounts in priority verticals such as transportation, logistics, construction, and field services. 
Collaborate with sales leadership to localize playbooks, refine go-to-market strategies, and strengthen our commercial footprint in México. 
Conduct needs-based discovery and deliver compelling presentations that translate Motive’s value into tangible business outcomes. 
Negotiate and close deals with professionalism and precision, ensuring a win-win outcome for customers and the company. 
Work cross-functionally with Customer Success, Sales Operations, and Marketing to ensure customer satisfaction and long-term success. 
Stay ahead of market trends, leveraging insights to enhance your consultative approach and strengthen your competitive positioning. 


What We’re Looking For


Demonstrated success as an SDR/BDR with strong outbound and closing exposure, or 1+ years of experience in full-cycle B2B sales (ideally within SaaS or technology). 
Proven ability to manage a high-velocity pipeline, maintain a rigorous daily activity cadence, and consistently exceed quota. 
Understanding of 1–2 month sales cycles with deal values typically in the mid-five-figure (USD) range. 
A true hunter mentality – resourceful, resilient, and passionate about winning new logos. 
Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills across all organizational levels. 
Comfort working in fast-paced, high-growth settings, with strong prioritization and self-management skills. 
Familiarity with Salesforce, Salesloft, Gong, Slack, and other modern sales tools. 
Experience selling into transportation, logistics, oil & gas, construction, or compliance and safety industries is a strong plus. 
Must currently reside in México and be fluent in Spanish and English. 


Why Join Motive

At Motive, we’re on a mission to transform the physical economy with cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights. You’ll join a global sales team that values ownership, continuous learning, and teamwork. We are committed to being a seedbed for talent, offering a clear growth path for ambitious professionals to evolve from development roles into high-impact closing positions. If you’re passionate about driving growth, building meaningful customer relationships, and shaping the future of Motive in Latin America — we’d love to meet you.

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

UK Candidate Privacy Notice here.

The applicant must be authorized to receive and access those commodities and technologies controlled under U.S. Export Administration Regulations. It is Motive's policy to require that employees be authorized to receive access to Motive products and technology. 

All job postings are for existing vacancies. Please note; some interviews or new-hire training sessions may be held in person at one of our global offices.
